metadata.name: rewindsafe-recovery
metadata.description: PROPOSED, not active in the live workspace (the live policy is the armoriq.yaml registration). RewindSafe recovery agent: allow the five recovery tools, deny privileged access restoration, and require approval for repairs that restore more than 5000 USD.

statements.reason: Restoring revoked access is an authority change. It is never part of a data-recovery plan.
Repairs restoring more than 5000 USD need a second reviewer.
